names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Μαΐου, «Άγιος Ονούφριος ο Ιερομάρτυρας», with the rank word left off; the life page adds that his name in the world was Αντώνιος Μαξίμοβιτς.

The day page's own `/name/9119.html` link carries in its `title` «Святитель Онуфрий (Гагалюк), архиепископ Курский, сщмч.», and the stored form is that with «Святитель» and the two trailing rank words left off — `hieromartyr` and `bishop` are in this folder's `types`. The surname in parentheses is part of the name and stays (BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2); the day's own line gives only «Сщмч. Онуфрия , архиеп. Курского (1938)», without it. The fuller «архиепископ Курский» was not folded into the form, the see belonging in `office` and the folder carrying none; adding one would cost four locale translations (BRIEF-ADDENDUM §4). `fk.mjs` on «Онуфрий (Гагалюк)» returned NONE before the write.

death.note: saint.gr: «Το 1938 μ.Χ. δολοφονείται για τη δράση του από ανθρώπους του καθεστώτος».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Онуфрия , архиеп. Курского (1938).»

attestations.note: The same man, and **this row settles what the folder's display name got wrong.** It reads «Onuphrius (Maksimovich)»; the calendar's life page gives his name in the world as **«Антоний Максимович Гагалюк»** — Maksimovich is the patronymic and **Гагалюк is the surname**. Everything else matches to the year: born 2 April 1889 in the province of Kholm against this folder's birth of 1889, shot 19 May 1938 against its death of 1938, and archbishop of Kursk in both. **`dates` were not touched** — the Russian gives the full date of birth where the folder holds the year, which is the same reading more precisely, and the schema holds years. **The display name was NOT changed**, that being one of the nine things a reader may not decide for a folder somebody else made; the author has the surname here and in this day's report. The day page prints no hymn for him. His name page lists «26 января (Новомуч.)» beside this day, the synaxis of the new martyrs, which is a company's feast and not a day of his own. azbyka.ru was not read.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Ονούφριος ο Ιερομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is neither of the corpus's two Onuphrii, `onuphrius-the-great` of the Egyptian desert nor `onuphrius-of-vorona`. The page prints «το 1915 μ.Χ.» twice, for the finishing of the academy and for the ordination, and that repetition is left as the page has it rather than resolved. No hymn.
